## TemplateEngine.\_rewriteScopeIdentifiers() method

Rewrites bare identifiers in a `<g-ifelse>` body to optional `data` reads.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _rewriteScopeIdentifiers(expr: string): string;
```

**Returns:**

string

Source with every scope read anchored to `data`

## Remarks

`user.name` becomes `data?.user?.name` — an optional chain, so a missing branch never throws — rather than `(data?.user).name`<!-- -->, which would. A member chain is consumed as a unit so the whole chain stays optional. Identifiers already qualified by `.`<!-- -->/`?.`<!-- -->, object-literal keys, arrow-function parameters, reserved words, and the standard globals are left alone; shorthand object properties are expanded so they keep reading from `data`<!-- -->.

## Example


```typescript
TemplateEngine._rewriteScopeIdentifiers(`user.isAdmin ? "admin" : "user"`);
// Result: 'data?.user?.isAdmin ? "admin" : "user"'
```
